title: Muon versus AdamW

paper.title: Muon: An optimizer for hidden layers in neural networks
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Muon versus AdamW: orthogonalize matrix momentum with Newton-Schulz iterations and compare with AdamW under a fixed token budget. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use tinyshakespeare; required output: [N,T] tokens -> [N,T,V] logits with matrix optimizer. Evaluate bpc (minimize). Handle rectangular matrices and nonmatrix parameters explicitly; Newton-Schulz finite outputs. Required ablation: Disable orthogonalization while retaining momentum and step schedule. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
